native_precision: float64 external arrays/results; sklearn CART computes feature splits internally in float32
thread_policy: n_jobs=1 where supported; all fit/predict calls inside threadpoolctl(limits=1)
memory_measurement: Linux process ru_maxrss upper bound including runtime/imports/prior calls, not per-fit allocation
context_policy: all rows passed once to native fit; no truncation or subsampling; counts refer to training context, not query rows
query_policy: feature-only batch in provided order; no query-dependent fitting
execution_lifecycle: stateless explicit train fit then predict per invocation; executor must charge one training fit per invocation; no additional fit or target calibration
preprocessing: finite prepared numeric features only; StandardScaler and optional univariate spline basis fit on training features only; target original units
calibration: identity temperature 1; native probabilities clipped then normalized in float64; no label-fitted calibration
label_codes: dense integers 0..K-1 in the declared opaque class order; every class must be observed

additive_spline_surrogate.family: transparent additive main-effects spline surrogate; not EBM

admission: simulated/public tiny CPU parity only; W00 owns wire/buffer/schema admission and isolated execution; D02 owns source provenance/rights; no external checkpoints or paid compute
